title: Browser Relay config
description: Plugin config persisted under plugins['browser'].* in ~/.pi/dashboard/config.json. Read by the server entry. The relay is OPT-IN: the manifest sets defaultEnabled:false AND this schema defaults enabled to false; enabling is a settings toggle. Per-profile SSO pairing tokens are writeOnly — the server strips them from every client-facing config payload (redactWriteOnly, spec browser-plugin-settings scenario F2).

enabled.description: Kill switch (distinct from the plugin toggle): when false the plugin stays loaded but relay routes answer 403 and live instances are closed synchronously.

defaultBrowser.description: Browser used by browser_connect when no target is given. "@dedicated" (default) = the dashboard-owned Chrome profile; "@headless" = the headless provider (no cdpUrl); any other value is a Chrome profileDirectory (a pre-existing value keeps this meaning). The "@" prefix is reserved for built-in targets and is never a profileDirectory.

allowMultipleInstancesPerProfile.description: When false (default), a second connect on a Chrome profile with a live instance gets 409 {reason:'busy'}; when true the relay allows concurrent instances on one Chrome profile. Does not apply to the dedicated browser, which is always single-client.

realProfile.description: Chrome profileDirectory used for the "my Chrome profile" step of the browser_connect fallback chain. Written whenever the user picks a profile; kept when defaultBrowser changes back to "@dedicated".

onUnavailable.description: What browser_connect does when the chosen browser is unavailable: ask = return the options to the agent, next = try the next browser in the fallback chain, stop = stop the task.

idleDisconnectMinutes.description: Close an agent browser instance after this many minutes without client commands or viewer input. 0 = never.

openLiveViewOnConnect.description: When true, the first agent-created tab after browser_connect opens in the live-view pane automatically.

allowedDomains.description: Global navigation guardrail, NOT a sandbox: Page.navigate / Target.createTarget to a host outside this list is denied. Exact host or leading-dot entry for subdomains. Empty = any host. A non-empty per-profile list overrides this one; the dedicated browser always uses this list.

browsers.description: Per-Chrome-profile settings keyed by profileDirectory — the stable key from Local State → profile.info_cache, never the user-editable label.

token.description: SSO pairing token pasted from the extension's connect page. writeOnly: never served back to any client; redactWriteOnly strips it from every broadcast and GET.

zeroDialog.description: When true, connect appends &token= to the connect.html URL so Chrome skips its Allow dialog. Token mismatch, Reject and no-answer are indistinguishable and all surface as the 60 s connect timeout (504).

allowedDomains.description: Navigation guardrail, NOT a sandbox: Page.navigate / Target.createTarget to a host outside this list is denied. Exact host or leading-dot entry for subdomains (.github.com admits api.github.com). Empty = any host allowed.
